Purpose

Build / test / lint commands

- No CI/build/test/lint scripts or package.json detected.
- Frontend (static): open frontend/index.html in a browser, or serve it locally:
  - cd frontend && python3 -m http.server 8000
- Backend: backend/ contains Python placeholders; no requirements.txt, entrypoint, or run scripts found.

High-level architecture (big picture)

- Frontend: static single-page with two tabbed forms (Career Recommendation, Roadmap Generation). Files: frontend/index.html, frontend/js/main.js, frontend/css/style.css.
- Backend (planned): Python (FastAPI or Flask) serving API endpoints that the frontend will call (not yet implemented). Data expected to live in MySQL.
- LLM integration planned: unified client for OpenAI/Anthropic; prompt templates stored in config/db; LLM used for intent detection, recommendation engine, and roadmap generation.
- Phased approach: Phase1 static HTML/JS (current) → Phase2 DB + Python API → Phase3 optional React migration → Phase4 LLM integration.

Key conventions and project-specific patterns

- Dynamic fields: elements marked with "<!-- todo: add data dynamically via JS -->" must be populated from GET /api/options (or equivalent) — do NOT hardcode interests, skills, industries, or locations into index.html.
- Forms: only two forms exist (Career Recommendation, Roadmap Generation). Do NOT add back the removed "Interest Finding" form.
- Task tracking: tasks.csv is the source-of-truth (local, not committed). docs/todo.md mirrors tasks.csv for GitHub — update both when tasks change. Do NOT commit tasks.csv.
- API contract (planned):
  - GET /api/options → { interests: [], skills: [], industries: [], locations: [] }
  - POST /api/career/recommend → { careers: [{ title, description, match_score, reasoning }] }
  - POST /api/roadmap/generate → { steps: [{ title, description, duration }] }
- File locations Copilot should read first: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/REQUIREMENTS.md, AGENTS.md, frontend/index.html, frontend/js/main.js, frontend/css/style.css, docs/todo.md.
- Do not edit tasks.csv unless explicitly asked by repository maintainers.

Other AI/agent configs present

- AGENTS.md and GEMINI.md exist; AGENTS.md contains repository-specific agent instructions — consult it before making automated edits.
- .github/skills/ contains guidance on project workflows and should be read for team/collaboration context.

When making changes

- Prefer small, surgical edits. Make changes that match the Phase1 → Phase2 migration plan in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.
- If adding runtime scripts (npm, Python requirements, Makefile), update README and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md with exact commands and add any new env variables to a single .env.example file.
